name: Portal stays up
ownerWords:
do we have api portal staging? your job is PM for api portal

wait but engage crawl not working?
goal: A customer who calls api.virev.ai never hits a dead portal or a dead crawler behind it. The prod checks of the portal openapi, crawler /health and crawler /health/schema pass all day, pass now, and still run every 5 min. The public docs page api.virev.ai/docs, signed out, is the same Scalar reference as /dashboard/docs (p110), and probes_down_now counts it when it is not. Prod carries every setting staging has, so a promote never ships code that reads a setting prod lacks. It holds the problem that came back most in this chat: promotes 8, 9, 10 and 12 each took the crawler behind api.virev.ai down, and a miss of probe_uptime_24h_pct starts a fix job on that (p39 today). env_keys_staging_only holds the other repeat, a promote that ships code reading a setting prod lacks, as BATCH_WORKER_SECRET did from 10-15 to 10-18.

metrics.label: Prod checks failing now (portal openapi, public /docs on Scalar, crawler health, crawler schema)
Minutes since the last prod check
Portal settings staging has and prod lacks (main and dev/sieun)

onMiss: Read the flagged rows. crawler_health or crawler_schema means the crawler behind the portal; portal_openapi means api.virev.ai. A public_docs_scalar row means api.virev.ai/docs is not the Scalar reference: before the portal promote that carries p110 that is expected and needs no job, and after it a miss is a regression that gets one fix job on staging. Follow ops/runbooks/api-portal-probe-down.md in auto-sns-agent, or api-portal-probe-stale.md for a stale probe, a series_missing or a source_error row (check the Convex cron "api health probe" and the api-portal-health scrape first). A portal outage gets one fix job here unless one is live; it fixes on staging (c50) and names the promote that carries the fix to prod, which the release owner walks with the owner (c154). A crawler outage: name the crawler chat 01a115e2 job that owns it, or start one fix job for it, with the target, error class and time. A past failure that recovered still misses the 24 h uptime: find when and why from api_probe_up, and start one fix job for its cause unless one is live. An env_staging_only row names api-portal keys that .env.staging has and .env lacks: add each to apps/api-portal/.env on dev/sieun with its prod value in a fix job, and the prod env push step of the next promote (vercel-blobs.mjs push in promote.yml) carries it to prod; name that promote. No outside sends (c37). Jobs land to staging on their own and leave prod promotes to the release owner, who walks each one with the owner (c154); only crawler, observability dashboard and demo.virev.ai deploys ship to prod without him. Tell the owner when a prod target is down now. All on target: end the turn with no message.
